questions.stem: The boy ______ is standing under the tree is my new classmate. He is from Canada.
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句关系代词的用法。先行词是'the boy'，指人，且在从句中作主语，因此用who。which用于指物；whom虽然指人，但只能作宾语；whose表示'...的'，在从句中作定语。口诀：先行词是人作主语用who，作宾语用whom/who，指物用which，表示所属用whose。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—______ you ______ your homework yet? 
—Yes, I ______ it an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在完成时与一般过去时的区别。第一空根据yet（常用于现在完成时疑问句和否定句）可知用现在完成时Have...finished；第二空根据时间状语an hour ago（具体过去时间）可知用一般过去时finished。现在完成时强调对现在的影响或与现在的联系，一般过去时强调动作发生在过去某个具体时间。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The new library ______ by the students last month. It looks very modern now.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般过去时的被动语态。主语'the new library'与动词build之间是被动关系，且时间状语last month表示过去，因此用was/were+过去分词结构。主语是单数，故用was built。被动语态结构：be+done，注意时态由be动词体现。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—Could you tell me ______?
—Sure. He has gone to the library to prepare for the exam.
questions.explanation: 本题考查宾语从句的语序和时态。宾语从句必须用陈述句语序（主语在前，谓语在后），排除A和C；根据答语'He has gone to...'可知问句应用现在完成时，强调对现在的影响（人现在不在这里），因此选B。宾语从句三注意：语序用陈述、时态看主句、连接词看句意。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: Please ______ the lights when you leave the classroom to save electricity.
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。turn off关闭；turn on打开；turn up调大（音量）；turn down调小（音量）。根据句意'离开教室时关灯省电'，应选turn off。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: It is ______ to swim in the river alone without adults' company. You'd better go with your parents.
questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换。句型'It is + adj. + to do sth.'表示'做某事是...的'，此处需要形容词作表语。danger是名词；dangerous是形容词；dangerously是副词；endanger是动词。根据句型结构选B。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The sports meeting will ______ next Friday morning. All students must arrive at the playground before 8:00.
questions.explanation: 本题考查take短语辨析。take up占据（时间/空间）、开始从事；take off起飞、脱下；take place发生、举行；take away带走。根据句意'运动会将于下周五上午举行'，应选take place。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，此处表示'张贴海报'。put up张贴、搭建；put off推迟；put on穿上、上演；put down放下、镇压。环保周活动开始前应该张贴海报宣传，因此选A。

Last month, our school environmental club organized a special activity called "Green Campus Week". The goal was to help students understand the importance of protecting our environment.

On Monday, we (8)______ posters around the school to tell everyone about the event. Many students stopped to read them and showed great interest. On Tuesday, we invited a speaker from a local environmental organization. He talked about how plastic pollution (9)______ marine life. His speech was so touching that many students decided to reduce using plastic bags.

The most exciting part was on Wednesday. We (10)______ a recycling competition between classes. Each class collected as many plastic bottles as possible. Class 8B won because they collected over 500 bottles. Everyone was surprised by their result.

During the week, I realized that small actions can make a big difference. I used to throw away bottles carelessly, but now I always put them in the recycling bin. I believe if everyone tries their best, we (11)______ a cleaner and greener world in the future. This experience has taught me that protecting the environment is not just a slogan, but a responsibility that (12)______ to all of us.

questions.explanation: 根据语境，演讲者讲的是塑料污染如何'影响'海洋生物。affect影响；protect保护；improve改善；save拯救。塑料污染对海洋生物应是负面影响，因此选B。

questions.stem: According to the passage, how many hours of sleep do teenagers aged 13-18 need per night?
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据文章第一段第二句'According to recent studies, teenagers aged 13-18 need about 8-10 hours of sleep per night.'可知，13-18岁青少年每晚需要8-10小时睡眠。做细节题时要准确定位关键词，找到原文对应句子。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Sleep is one of the most important parts of our daily life, but many teenagers don't get enough of it. According to recent studies, teenagers aged 13-18 need about 8-10 hours of sleep per night. However, most students in big cities like Shenzhen only sleep 6-7 hours because of heavy schoolwork and the use of electronic devices.

Dr. Li, a sleep researcher at a local hospital, explains that lack of sleep can seriously affect students' health and academic performance. "When you don't sleep enough, your brain cannot work at its full capacity," he says. "This makes it harder to concentrate in class and remember new information." He also points out that chronic sleep deprivation (长期睡眠不足) may lead to obesity and mental health problems.

To solve this problem, some schools have changed their schedules. For example, No. 1 Middle School now starts classes at 8:30 AM instead of 7:30 AM. "The extra hour makes a huge difference," says Wang Ming, a 15-year-old student there. "I feel more energetic and can focus better on my studies."

Experts suggest several ways to improve sleep quality. First, avoid using smartphones or computers at least one hour before bedtime because the blue light from screens suppresses (抑制) the production of melatonin (褪黑素), a hormone that helps you sleep. Second, keeping a regular sleep schedule, even on weekends, helps regulate your body clock. Finally, creating a comfortable sleep environment with proper temperature and darkness is also essential.

options: A. He used to be late for school every day.
B. He prefers studying late at night.

questions.explanation: 推理判断题。根据第三段Wang Ming的话'The extra hour makes a huge difference'和'I feel more energetic and can focus better on my studies'可推断，推迟上课时间让他受益良多，精力更充沛，学习更专注。A、B、D选项在原文中没有依据。推理题要基于原文信息合理推断，不能过度推测。

questions.group_passage:
Developing good study habits is essential for middle school students. Here are some tips that can help you study more effectively.

(17)______ First, find a quiet place away from noise and distractions. Make sure your desk is clean and organized. This helps you focus better on your homework.

(18)______ Don't try to study for four hours without a break. Your brain needs time to rest and process information. Try the Pomodoro Technique: study for 25 minutes, then take a 5-minute break. This method can improve your concentration significantly.

(19)______ When you encounter difficult problems, don't hesitate to ask your teachers or classmates for help. Discussing with others can give you new perspectives and help you understand the material better.

(20)______ Lack of sleep affects your memory and learning ability. Make sure you get at least 8 hours of sleep every night so that you can be energetic the next day.

Remember, forming good habits takes time. Start with small steps and be consistent. Soon you will see improvement in your studies.
